_comment: Mirror of the file-write allow list in ~/.config/seatbelt/ai-agents.sb (2026-10-17). Edit both together. warrant refuses an executable under these paths and re-hashes argument files under them right before launch. The project dir of a run-agent session is also writable but unknown here; ~/git/src covers the usual repos. ~/.local/bin (mise) and ~/.local/share/claude (claude update) are trusted because the profile no longer lets agents write them.
